source: v88 0.35 m approach made three distant sources launch and three receivers touch safely, but contact deflected sideways and no shot option activated
policy_class: one-parameter observation-conditioned motor target residual; bias is perpendicular to the live ball-to-teammate vector, not a world-axis or ball-state edit
paired_zero_bias: v88 standoff0.35 same three consumed scenes
selection: Hard gate: six safe bodies and clean foot-to-foot transfer in all three. Rank eligible arms by total genuine later finisher foot-shot contacts with post-contact ball speed >=2 m/s, then in-goal crossings, then minimum joint margin. If no arm improves genuine later shot contacts over zero bias, reject lateral bias as a learning direction.
interpretation: This is direct-physics episodic policy-parameter learning on consumed scenes; it is not a neural network or a Fresh exam. Any selection must be frozen and tested on new scenes.
